from_quote: The new powers vested in the United States, are, to regulate commerce
rationale: The paragraph lists among the new powers "to regulate commerce", the power of Article I, Section 8, clause 3.

from_quote: provide for a uniform practice respecting naturalization, bankruptcies
rationale: The paragraph names the power over uniform rules of naturalization and bankruptcies.
to_quote: To establish an uniform Rule of Naturalization, and uniform Laws on the subject of Bankruptcies

from_quote: organizing, arming and training the militia
rationale: The paragraph names the power to provide for "organizing, arming" the militia.
to_quote: To provide for organizing, arming, and disciplining, the Militia

from_quote: for promoting the progress of science in the mode therein pointed out
rationale: The paragraph names the power for "promoting the progress of science".
to_quote: To promote the Progress of Science and useful Arts

from_quote: nor can any appropriation of money for that purpose be in force more than two years
rationale: The paragraph names the two-year limit on appropriations for armies.
to_quote: no Appropriation of Money to that Use shall be for a longer Term than two Years

from_quote: The regulating of time, place and manner of elections seems to be as well secured as possible; the legislature of each state may do it, and if they neglect to do it in the best manner, it may be done by Congress
rationale: The paragraph names the clause on the time, place and manner of elections, set by each state legislature and alterable by Congress.
to_quote: The Times, Places and Manner of holding Elections

from_quote: the qualifications of the electors are to remain as fixed by the constitutions and laws of the several states
rationale: The paragraph names the provision tying the qualifications of electors to those of the states.
to_quote: the Electors in each State shall have the Qualifications requisite for Electors of the most numerous Branch of the State Legislature

from_quote: the partial negative vested in the President by the new Constitution on the acts of Congress and the subsequent revision
rationale: The paragraph names the president's qualified negative on bills and their reconsideration by Congress.

from_quote: when the members of the senate are equally divided on any question, who so proper to give a casting vote
rationale: The paragraph names the provision that the vice-president, as president of the senate, votes when the senate is equally divided.
to_quote: shall have no Vote, unless they be equally divided

from_quote: The power of the President to grant pardons extends only to offences committed against the United States
rationale: The paragraph names the pardon power for offences against the United States and its exception for impeachments.
to_quote: Power to grant Reprieves and Pardons for Offences against the United States, except in Cases of Impeachment

from_quote: except those claiming lands under grants of different states
rationale: The paragraph echoes the words of the judicial power clause on citizens of the same state "claiming lands under grants of different states".
to_quote: claiming Lands under Grants of different States

from_quote: it provides an easy and peaceable mode to make amendments
rationale: The paragraph names the Constitution's provision of a mode of making amendments, which is Article V.
